About us

We are a locally owned business that has grown steadily by word of mouth. Our customers come back because we keep our promises, we explain every step clearly and we never surprise anyone with hidden costs. Our team is small, experienced and easy to reach, and every enquiry is handled by someone who knows the work well.

We work with individuals, families, small companies and institutions. Whether you are taking your first step or you have worked with many providers before, we will take time to understand what you need and recommend the option that fits your budget, your timeline and the location you have in mind.

What we do

Consultations and site visits, clear written quotations, scheduling that works around your timetable, and support after the job is done. We keep records of every project and every client so that follow-up questions are answered quickly. We also partner with trusted professionals for anything outside our core work, so you only need to deal with one team.

Our office is open Monday to Saturday from 8am to 6pm. You are welcome to visit, but most clients prefer to start on WhatsApp where we can share photos, documents and quotations instantly. We are proud of the reviews our customers leave and we read every one of them.

Ask us about current availability, delivery timelines and payment options. We are happy to send references from recent clients in your area.

Contact

Areas we serve

Our customers come from all over Nairobi and the neighbouring counties, including Westlands, Kilimani, Kileleshwa, Lavington, Karen, Lang'ata, South B, South C, Embakasi, Kasarani, Ruaka, Ruiru, Juja, Thika, Kitengela, Athi River, Syokimau and Rongai. If you are not sure whether we cover your area, send us a message and we will confirm the same day. We plan our schedule a week ahead, so it helps to let us know early about bigger jobs, but we always try to fit in urgent requests.

We keep things simple: a clear quotation, an agreed timeline, regular updates and a final walk-through with you before we close the job. Payment terms are explained upfront and receipts are issued for every transaction.
